The phone is the national headquarters line, not a chapter line. National site says more than 5,000 members in more than 418 chapters. No dated chapter activity found.

records.name: Achieveability
records.summary: A West Philadelphia nonprofit that works to lift families out of poverty through education, affordable housing, and support services. It runs family programs and invites volunteers.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer through the group's site, ask about its family programs such as Family Self-Sufficiency and WorkSmart West Philly, or attend a public event.

first_step.how: Email info@achieve-ability.org or call 215-748-8800 to ask how to volunteer or join a family program
first_step.basis: Volunteer and event links exist, but the sign-up steps and program eligibility are not explained on the pages read.

records.notes: Legal name on the IRS filing is Achieveability Community Development Corporation, with an address (2042 to 48 Arch Street) that matches Mission First Housing Group's headquarters. The batch website (MISSIONFIRSTHOUSING.ORG) is Mission First's site, not this group's. The group's own nonprofit site (achieveability.org) was found and used; the link between the IRS filer and that site is not confirmed. Site has no dated items (45th anniversary gala named, not dated), so status is probably_active on a working site with no dates. Published office hours conflict between sections, so hours were left out.

first_step.basis: No public page was found, so the way in is unclear.

records.name: AGA Philadelphia Chapter
records.summary: The Philadelphia chapter of a national association of government accountants and public finance professionals. It offers continuing education trainings, public events, student outreach, and community service.
records.what_you_do: Chapter members take part in trainings and thought-leadership events; the chapter also runs student outreach and community service projects.

first_step.how: Read the membership page at philadelphia.agacgfm.org/membership, then use the chapter's contact page to ask whether a guest can attend an event
first_step.basis: Membership is the main route in, and the site does not say whether non-members can attend chapter events.

records.notes: Dated item: a Temple University Career Day engagement dated November 18, 2025 (excerpt cut off). IRS filing address is a PO box; no meeting place is listed on the site, so no location was written. Social accounts exist (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X) but their URLs were not read, so none are recorded.

records.name: AL DÍA Foundation
records.summary: A foundation linked to the AL DÍA news organization. It works with colleges to recruit, train, and support Latino and other underrepresented students in journalism, and its best-known program is a student fellowship.
records.what_you_do: Students take part in the Felix Varela Fellowship, which places fellows in a newsroom.

first_step.how: Use the Contact page linked from aldianewsfound.org to ask when the next Felix Varela Fellowship class opens
first_step.basis: The fellowship is for students and needs an application; no open public events were found.

records.notes: Newest dated item found: a fellows reception on August 31, 2022. Undated claims on the homepage (29 years of work, 2010 founding) are not evidence of current activity. The IRS filing address is 1835 Market Street, not written on the site pages read. Phone and email were not found on the pages read; the Contact page was not read. Foundation is separate from AL DÍA News, the newspaper. Dormant status means the record should be checked before it goes live.

records.notes: Single chapter of an international social sorority. National site has 2026 items (international governing board installation; scholarships for academic year 2026). Hidden as private.

records.name: American Federation of Government Employees
records.notes: National labor union. The national site says membership is for government workers nationwide and overseas, so the public cannot join. No Philadelphia local or chapter page was found on the national site. National site has dated 2026 news (October 5, 2026 and September 28, 2026). IRS address is 700 Arch Street. Separate filer from the 19107 record. Hidden as private (members only).

notes: Batch of 15 IRS groups. Verdicts: 7 publish (Questers chapters 1507-ellarslie and abigail-flanner-1524 as unknown, achieveability-community-development-corporation as probably_active, aga-philadelphia-chapter as active, al-dia-foundation as dormant, and action-alliance and actions-for-animals as unknown with no source, so they will be held back); 1 out_of_area (allentown, a judgment from the name, needs a human check); 3 hide private (alpha-chi sorority chapter, two AFGE locals); 2 not_a_group (ambo-inc, anarcho-syndicalist-review); 2 blocked with no record (AAHGS and ASMP, both 403). Searches: the two-search cap was used on Action Alliance and Actions for Animals, which had no usable website; neither search found the group's own page. Questers join page guessed URL returned 404. Batch website for achieveability (MISSIONFIRSTHOUSING.ORG) belongs to Mission First Housing Group, so the group's own site was found separately. Fetches used 15 of the 60 allowed. No rate limiting was seen on other domains. Budget was not exhausted by fetches; it was exhausted by searches.
